description: Distributed configuration store backing Patroni. If etcd loses quorum, Patroni cannot fail over and the cluster goes read-only.

panels.title: Members Up
panels.description: Each site runs a 3-member cluster. 2 members are the minimum for quorum; at 1 the cluster is read-only.

panels.title: Leader Changes (range)
panels.description: Frequent leader elections usually mean slow disks or a saturated network between members.

panels.title: Pending Proposals
panels.description: A backlog of uncommitted Raft proposals — the cluster is falling behind.

panels.title: Quota Usage
panels.description: Reaching the backend quota puts etcd into a read-only alarm state and Patroni stops being able to update the cluster key.

panels.title: Proposals Committed / s
panels.description: Divergence between members here means one is lagging behind Raft.

panels.title: Slow Applies / s
panels.description: Apply operations that exceeded etcd's internal warning threshold.

panels.title: Slow / Failed Read Indexes per s
WAL fsync Duration p99 / p50
panels.description: The single most important etcd metric. p99 above 25 ms causes leader elections and Patroni failovers.

panels.title: Defragmentation In-flight
panels.description: etcd blocks all reads and writes while defragmenting.

panels.title: DB Size (total vs in use)
panels.description: A large gap between total and in-use means fragmentation — run a defrag during a maintenance window.

panels.title: Revisions (current vs compacted)
panels.description: A widening gap means compaction is not keeping up.

panels.title: Peer Round-Trip Time p99
panels.description: Raft heartbeats travel this path. High RTT triggers elections.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (instance, To, le) (rate(etcd_network_peer_round_trip_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"etcd_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Client gRPC Traffic
panels.description: Almost all of this is Patroni polling and updating the cluster key.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, grpc_code) (rate(grpc_server_handled_total{job=~"etcd_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance", grpc_code!="OK"}[$__rate_interval]))
process_open_fds{job=~"etcd_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} / clamp_min(process_max_fds{job=~"etcd_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}, 1) * 100

panels.title: Lease Activity / s
panels.description: Patroni holds the leader key on a lease. Unexpected revocations mean the leader lost its lock.

title: etcd — HQ & DR
